verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or account-wide data export in open formats, and no offboarding or data-portability feature. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server and webhooks are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not an export capability. Per-item syncs (follow-ups to GitHub/GitLab issues, actions to Asana, audit logs to Datadog) are adjacent integrations, not a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
